description: Model profiles shared by all three agents.
'default' names the profile used when no --profile (or --local / --openai) flag picks one.
Precedence: --model / --base-url, then the environment variables named by model_env /
base_url_env, then (with model_auto) the model loaded on the server (LM Studio), then the
The key comes from the variable named by api_key_env; api_key is only a fallback for
servers that need no real key.
error_hints: "openai" gives OpenAI-specific advice (key, quota, billing) when a request
fails; without it, errors point at the server and the model instead.
max_tokens: the most tokens one reply may use, thinking included: a reasoning model spends
thousands thinking before it answers. Used by the pull request gate's quiz writer; the agents
do not limit their replies. Without it, the server's own limit applies.
